snippet.title: Level 250 Paladin vs Mortharion the Bone Dragon | Zarethia Gameplay
snippet.description:
A level 250 paladin hunts the Dragon Graveyard and its floors, then takes on Mortharion the Bone Dragon alone.

Dragon Graveyard: Liches and Undead Dragons
Floor −1, Ossuary Tunnels: Undead Dragons and Bone Crawlers
Floor +1, Bone Ridges: Undead Dragons and Carrion Vultures
Boss: Mortharion the Bone Dragon, level 251

Zarethia is a free pixel-art MMORPG for Android and PC: https://zarethia.com

#Zarethia #MMORPG #PixelArt #IndieGame
